explanation: Compared against OEIS A238281 (Sun): a(n) = #{0 < k < n : (kn,(k+1)n) and ((k+1)n,(k+2)n) contain equally many primes}; conjecture (i): a(n) > 0 for n > 1. The Lean `a` compares π((k+1)n) − π(kn) with π((k+2)n) − π((k+1)n) for k ∈ [1, n), exactly as the Mathematica program; for n ≥ 2 and k ≥ 1 the right endpoints (k+1)n, (k+2)n are composite, so half-open and open interval counts agree. Test values match the data. The statement is the conjecture. Faithful.
